criteria.description: Expired (kept) next expiry schedules the kept-retry interval (3600s), not the 60s floor
Future expiry schedules exactly; 60s floor only for near-future items
One do_sweep() with 3 users and 2 grace hashes calls _get_profile_ids at most once per user
T10121 safety behavior unchanged (existing sweep/auto-export suites green)
complete game with missing athlete recap is stitched by the sweep, recap_video_url set, ref reclaimed same run (test_complete_game_missing_athlete_recap_is_stitched_and_reclaimed)
abandoned game with missing recap is stitched, moves to complete with attempts unchanged, ref reclaimed (test_abandoned_game_missing_recap_is_stitched_and_reclaimed)
ensure_recap raising keeps the ref, logs ERROR with game/layer, sweep does not crash (test_ensure_recap_raising_keeps_ref_and_logs_error)
a zero-play layer is never stitched (test_zero_play_layer_is_never_stitched)
existing T10121 sweep tests stay green (full tests/test_sweep_scheduler.py in green log, 53 passed)
Every [R2_CALL] line carries source=; request sources are route templates with no ids (incl. calls on s3transfer worker threads); 404 -> unmatched
A request to a route that writes R2 increments (today, env, route template, A, PutObject) by exactly the PUTs it made; untagged unchanged
A sweep run's ListObjectsV2 calls count under source 'sweep'

analytics.sqlite upload is HEAD-etag CAS; a conflict refuses (no PUT, foreign bytes intact), logs CRITICAL naming the foreign writer, freezes with zero further R2 calls, keeps local counts; unconfirmed baseline never uploads
The store's own R2 ops are counted under analytics_store but never make the shard dirty (idle store makes zero R2 calls); shutdown flush cannot hang on a held lock
No regression in the storage sync / intro upload / sweep / export / poster-warm corner (managed-transfer rebinding touches every DB sync)
